﻿# Fix Maven Compilation Failure: mysql-connector-java 5.1.49->8.0.28

## Context

Project has a **COMPILATION_FAILURE** after a dependency upgrade bot bumped `mysql-connector-java` from `5.1.49` to `8.0.28`.

## Your Task

The source code is in the WORKDIR. Fix all compilation errors so that `mvn compile` succeeds.

## Steps
I'll analyze the compilation failure and fix the issues caused by the MySQL connector upgrade.

    <dependencyManagement>

            <dependency>
                <groupId>org.jmockit</groupId>
                <artifactId>jmockit</artifactId>
                <version>${jmockit.version}</version>
            </dependency>
            <dependency>
                <groupId>junit</groupId>
                <artifactId>junit</artifactId>
                <version>4.13.2</version>

            <groupId>mysql</groupId>

        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.postgresql</groupId>

        </dependency>

        <dependency>
            <groupId>com.oracle.database.jdbc</groupId>
            <artifactId>ojdbc8</artifactId>

        <dependency>

        </dependency>

        <dependency>
            <groupId>com.ibm.db2</groupId>
            <artifactId>jcc</artifactId>

            <groupId>org.jmockit</groupId>

        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.apache.commons</groupId>
            <artifactId>commons-lang3</artifactId>

        <dependency>
            <groupId>commons-codec</groupId>

        <dependency>
            <groupId>com.google.inject</groupId>
            <artifactId>guice</artifactId>

        <dependency>

                            </tag>
                            <tag>
                                <name>implSpec</name>
                                <placement>a</placement>

                            <tag>

                        <goals>

                                            <time>40000</time>
                                            <log>Service Broker manager has started</log>
                                            <exec>
                                                <!--
                                                Prepare a new "pdb" database for tests with READ_COMMITTED_SNAPSHOT enabled
                                                 (required for SQL server to have the same behavior as other DBs in READ_COMMITTED
                                                 isolation level) and ALLOW_SNAPSHOT_ISOLATION enabled to allow using the
                                                 TRANSACTION_SNAPSHOT level (equivalent to SERIALIZABLE in PostgreSQL and Oracle).
                                                A new database needs to be used because the flags can't be enabled on "master" database.
                                                -->
                                                <postStart>/opt/mssql-tools/bin/sqlcmd -l 45 -U sa -P AaBb12.# -Q CREATE\ DATABASE\ pdb;\ ALTER\ DATABASE\ pdb\ SET\ READ_COMMITTED_SNAPSHOT\ ON;\ ALTER\ DATABASE\ pdb\ SET\ ALLOW_SNAPSHOT_ISOLATION\ ON</postStart>

steps.message:
Compilation succeeds. Here's a summary of the fixes:

## Summary

The MySQL Connector/J 8.x migration introduced package structure changes. I fixed two files:

### 1. `MySqlQueryExceptionHandler.java` (line 21)
**Changed import:**
- Old: `com.mysql.jdbc.exceptions.MySQLTimeoutException`
- New: `com.mysql.cj.jdbc.exceptions.MySQLTimeoutException`

### 2. `DatabaseEngineDriver.java` (line 95)
**Changed driver class:**
- Old: `com.mysql.jdbc.Driver`
- New: `com.mysql.cj.jdbc.Driver`

The `mvn compile` now completes successfully with BUILD SUCCESS.
